local frame = 0
function Tick(self, dt)
 frame = frame + 1
 if frame == 1 then
  local target = CallFunction("Animator.SetIKTarget", {name="Goal", x=1, y=1, z=0, positionWeight=0.5})
  local fade = CallFunction("Animator.CrossFade", {layer="Base", state="Move", duration=1})
  if not target or not fade then error("animator setup failed") end
 elseif frame == 2 then
  local fade = CallFunction("Animator.CrossFade", {layer="Base", state="Idle", duration=0.5})
  if not fade then error("animator interruption failed") end
 elseif frame == 3 then
  local state = CallFunction("Animator.State", {layer="Base"})
  if state.state ~= "Idle" or not state.transitioning then error("animator debug mismatch") end
  local curve = CallFunction("Animator.Curve", {name="FootPlant"})
  if type(curve) ~= "number" or curve <= 0 or curve >= 1 then error("curve sampling failed") end
  Log("animator-workflow-pass")
 end
end
